mapper.select: SELECT artwork_id AS artworkId, current_share_price AS price FROM artwork_markets WHERE is_tradable = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE artwork_markets SET current_share_price = #{price}, volume_24h = volume_24h + #{price} * 100 WHERE artwork_id = #{artworkId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM order_book_orders WHERE artwork_id = #{artworkId} AND is_vmm = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_book_orders (artwork_id, user_id, side, price, size, remaining_size, status, is_vmm) VALUES (#{artworkId}, NULL, #{side}, #{price}, #{size}, #{size}, 'open', 1)
INSERT INTO trade_executions (artwork_id, buyer_user_id, seller_user_id, side, price, size, notional, source) VALUES (#{artworkId}, NULL, NULL, #{side}, #{price}, #{size}, #{price} * #{size}, 'vmm')
